eventDetail.scope: AUTOCOM-26 envisions a dynamic platform for global researchers, industry professionals, and academicians to converge and exchange insights in the realms of Communication Devices, Signal Processing, Computer Security, Cybersecurity, Data Science, Big Data, Blockchain, Deep Learning, Intelligent Systems, VLSI, 5G, Channel Modeling, MIMO Communication Systems, Microwave Communication Devices, Terahertz Communication, RFID Technologies, Smart Agriculture, Healthcare, Internet of Things, Cloud Computing, Management Systems, WSN, Sensor Deployment, and the Metaverse. This collaborative forum aims to foster interdisciplinary discussions, propel technological advancements, and pave the way for innovative solutions addressing the multifaceted challenges of our interconnected world.
